meta.title: Questing: what's on near you
meta.description: Questing is a shared events calendar for your town. Clubs, associations, venues and student organizations post their events there, and you can browse them on a list or a map.
intro.title: Find out what's happening near you.
intro.body1: Questing is a shared events calendar for your town. Clubs, associations, venues and student organizations post their events there, and you can browse them on a list or a map.
intro.body2: You can follow the organizers you like, say you're going, and see which of your friends are going too.
intro.screenshot: The Upcoming tab in Questing: a pub quiz, a bouldering session and a board game night, with the friends who are going.
who.title: Who it's for
who.everyone: Anyone looking for something to do. You don't have to be a student, and you don't need to know anyone already: open the app and see what's on tonight or this weekend.
who.students: Students get one extra. When you verify your university email, you'll also see events that are only open to students of your university, like your guild's parties.
who.organizers: And anyone who organizes things, from student unions to choirs, sports clubs and bars with a quiz night. Posting events costs nothing.
organizers.title: For organizers
organizers.intro: Create an organization, invite the people you run it with, and start posting. A few things that help:
organizers.capacity: Capacity limits with a waiting list, ticket links, prices and age limits.
organizers.cohost: Hosting an event together with another organization.
organizers.import: Importing a calendar you already keep (an iCal link). It stays in sync after that.
organizers.message: Sending a message to everyone who's coming, and asking for feedback afterwards.
organizers.dashboard: A dashboard with views, sign-ups and new followers, and a list of your events to embed on your own website.
organizers.verified: A verified badge for official organizations.
facts.title: Good to know
facts.priceText: Free, for everyone who uses it and for organizers.
facts.whereText: In your browser, at app.questing.fi. Apps for iPhone and Android are coming.
facts.privacyText: Your account can be private. You can block or mute people, and download or delete your data whenever you like.
